title: Patch: drop the square shadow behind the card face's cost gem
thread:
**Issue #3329 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #3329: Patch: drop the square shadow behind the card face's cost gem
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

## What players see

On a card face (hand preview, inspect view, almanac), there's a faint square box behind the hexagonal mana crystal in the top-left corner. It shows up most clearly where it overlaps the frame and the art window. It was reported on Call to Chaos (Training-Grounds Edition), but it shows on every face.

## Cause

There are two rules for `.cost-gem`:

- `apps/web/src/game/board.css:1233` is the older round gem for board tiles. It sets `border`, `border-radius: var(--radius-round)`, `background` and **`box-shadow: var(--shadow-2)`** (`0 4px 12px` black at 50%).
- `apps/web/src/cards/cards.css:324` (`.cf .cost-gem`) restyles the gem as a hexagon for `CardFace.tsx` and `MinionFace.tsx`. It resets `border: 0`, `border-radius: 0` and `background: none`, but it never resets `box-shadow`.

So the face gem keeps board.css's shadow, now drawn around a square box (radius 0) instead of a circle. The hexagon itself is the clipped `::before` (`cards.css:349`), which already has its own `filter: drop-shadow(...)` that follows the hex outline. The square shadow behind it is the extra box.

I checked this with a standalone page that loads the app's real stylesheets in Chromium:
- `getComputedStyle(.cf .cost-gem).boxShadow` is `rgba(0,0,0,0.5) 0px 4px 12px 0px` and `border-radius` is `0px`.
- Setting `box-shadow: none` on the gem makes the square disappear, and the hexagon's own drop shadow stays.

## Fix

- Add `box-shadow: none;` to `.cf .cost-gem` in `apps/web/src/cards/cards.css` with the other resets (border, border-radius, background). Leave board.css's `.cost-gem` alone, since board tiles still use it.
- Check that nothing else in `cards/` (`cosmetics.css`, `glitch.css`, `stamps.css`, the full-art and minion-layout rules) relies on that shadow being there.

## Acceptance

- [ ] A web unit test, or a component/pixel spec under `e2e/` if that fits better, that pins `.cf .cost-gem` to no box shadow. It can be as simple as asserting `box-shadow: none` sits in the `.cf .cost-gem` rule, so the reset can't be dropped again.
- [ ] Screenshot of a spell face and a minion face in the inspect view, before and after, attached to the PR. The square is gone and the hexagon still has its own drop shadow.
- [ ] `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and the five required checks are green.
```
